OpenCode's equivalent is the native session.error ProviderAuthError event, already
covered by opencode_session::tests::provider_auth_error_is_terminal_and_other_errors_settle_to_idle_with_a_reason.
Its "Connect a provider" command also serves authenticated users choosing another
provider, so that title alone is not evidence of a logged-out seat.
